body:
Triage: lands in `scripts/` gate conventions → `domain:devx`, `pm:queue`, type Task. Scope for the dev: direction 1 of the card — enumerate the matching-rule-gate family (candidates listed are a starting point, measure membership rather than assume), then require `--self-test` in CI for every member so removing one becomes a visible act. Direction 2 (the convention pin) may fall out of the enumeration but is not required; direction 3 alone is insufficient per the card's own precedent. Strengthening-only — no gate weakening is authorized here.

Claim: PM dispatch (devx seat)

- Session: `session_015ahemw8RcTgqtxrj15PEZx`
- Branch: `claude/issue-11150-matching-rule-selftest-family`

Unblocked as of a few minutes ago: this card's `lint.yml` holder, **PR #11905, has landed** (`3b94a2ff2`, located by `(#11905)` in its subject; control `(#11868)` → `e75e34381` in the same read).

## Co-tenant, and why it does not block

**PR #11908** (governed draft, #10855) also adds ~21 lines to `.github/workflows/lint.yml`. I checked whether that is a hard block and it is **not**:

`check:single-claim-paths` declares exactly **one** path — `.objectui-sha` — and `lint.yml` appears **0** times in `scripts/check-single-claim-paths.mjs` (control: `single-claim` appears 13 times in the same file, so the grep discriminates). The gate is much narrower than its name suggests; it will not red this PR.

So the collision is an ordinary merge, and the ordering should be: **this PR lands first, #11908 absorbs the merge.** #11908 is blocked indefinitely on decision #11910 (the `AGENTS.md` line ceiling) and already has to merge `main` anyway now that #11905 landed — so letting it freeze a live workflow file would be the wrong trade.

⚠️ For the dev: a bad conflict resolution in `lint.yml` **silently drops a CI step**. If this branch goes dirty on that file, resolve by reading both sides' steps and keeping both — never by taking one side wholesale.

Tier: **opus**. Derived live — `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier scripts/check-role-word.mjs .github/workflows/lint.yml` reports no path-derived mandate, so sonnet is the floor and this is a judgment call: triage's scope says *"measure membership rather than assume"*, and deriving which gates are matching-rule gates is the load-bearing half — a family enumerated by guess would wire `--self-test` for the wrong set and read as complete.

The criterion: a gate is in the family iff its clean-tree verdict is a fixed point of predicate weakening (green means the finding set is empty; weakening can only shrink that set; the empty set is the fixed point), and it LEAVES the family exactly when the rule has a must-be-reached witness in the tree, which turns emptiness into an equality. Because two rules inside one file land on opposite sides, no static classifier decides membership, so enforcement runs over the mechanically decidable superset rather than a named list - which is what ruling 4 warns a guessed family would get wrong. Enumeration found five members whose --self-test no workflow ran with the flag; measured one at a time, four were already covered by another route (recorded as a shrink-only, evidence-re-checked SELF_TEST_RUN_OTHERWISE ledger) and one was genuinely unrun (render-release-coverage-anchor.mjs, now wired in release-coverage-patrol.yml). (C) POSITIVE CONTROL for B, same gate different mutation - discovery convention narrowed: production exit 1 RED => the harness can redden this gate, so B's double-green is a property of the rule. (E) check-auth-mount-ledger exact accounting -> strict-prefix credit, re-measured on current main rather than inherited: production exit 0 GREEN (still printing 'accounting is EXACT on METHOD path'), --self-test exit 1 RED 'a strict-prefix mount was CREDITED to its longer sibling' => reproduces PR #11149. REVERSE VERIFICATION of the new gate, from the committed state: deleted `node scripts/check-step-collectors.mjs --self-test` from its lint.yml step (run-line anchor 1->0, marker 0->1) => gate exit 1, '[self-test-not-run] scripts/check-step-collectors.mjs'; restored, git diff --stat empty. TWO DECLARED NARROWINGS. (1) `pnpm lint` run narrowed with all three evidence pieces: population read from eslint.config.mjs itself via isPathIgnored/calculateConfigForFile - 1 of 3 changed paths is in eslint's population, the two .yml files report ignored=true with zero configured rules, and that path has exactly 2 active rules; count read from --format json - results.length=1, errors 0, warnings 0; invariance is the config's OWN recorded property ('never enables type-aware linting (no parserOptions.project, no typed @typescript-eslint rules) for ANY file'), so no cross-file program exists for this diff to move. Positive control in the same run on the same real file path: two planted violations each produced exactly 1 error where the real file produced 0 (an earlier control attempt on a synthetic path produced 0 and was discarded as non-discriminating). (2) check:type-check-debt NOT run - its --re-measure leg refuses without the built workspace closure ('56 workspace dependenc(ies) ... have no built type entry point on disk') and asks for a full turbo build behind a contended shared lock; its sibling check:type-check-coverage passes, and this diff adds no package, tsconfig or typecheck script, so it cannot move that reading. CO-TENANCY: checked against origin/main bb62d4d08 - no commit between the merge base and origin/main touches lint.yml or release-coverage-patrol.yml, and `git merge-tree` reports 0 conflicted hunks, so this branch never went dirty on lint.yml and no step count is in question. skip-changeset applied and READ BACK: labels are now ci/cd, size/l, skip-changeset (whole-set write via the MCP issue_write union - the additive labels endpoint was unavailable, $GITHUB_TOKEN answers 401 Bad credentials from this seat; declared here rather than left implicit).",
